title: Correlation emergence and the Epps effect in two coupled limit order books
summary: We give a unified analytic account of correlation emergence and the Epps effect in two coupled limit order books. The Epps effect is the empirical reduction in measured cross-asset log-return correlation at short aggregation scales, or equivalently the recovery of measured correlation as the aggregation interval increases. The model starts from a fixed-grid discrete random walk for order flow in operational time, with creation, cancellation and diffusion.
